rationale: The customer sets aside the earlier invoice question and asks whether a petrol pressure washer is available to book, which is a standard availability request.
The customer is asking for their account and all personal data held about them to be deleted and confirmed, which is a data deletion request.
The customer needs to move the dates on an existing pressure washer booking, which is a standard booking change.
The customer wants an explanation of the charges on their floor saw rental invoice, which is a standard invoice query.
The customer is asking for confirmation that the damage waiver is already included in the daily rate before their next booking, which is a standard question the published rate policy can answer.
The customer is asking about return logistics for the concrete breaker at the end of the rental, which is a standard collection/return question.
The customer is asking whether a diesel generator is available for a site, which is a standard availability request.
The customer needs to change the dates on a plate compactor booking because their site work was delayed, which is a standard booking change.
The customer is asking Haapaharju Oy to honour a price match that a named staff member, Petri Isokangas, agreed to earlier in this thread.
The customer needs to move the dates on a plate compactor booking due to a delayed site schedule, which is a standard booking change.
The email reports a worker receiving an electric shock from a rented generator, which is a safety incident.
The customer is asking whether a diamond floor saw is available to book for an upcoming job, which is a standard availability request.
The customer is proposing a specific 22% discount on a large multi-site booking, which is a commercial price negotiation rather than something covered by standard policy.
The customer is chasing an overdue refund for a booking Haapaharju Oy itself cancelled due to a unit breakdown, which is a standard refund matter even though the tone is frustrated.
The customer is asking for an unrecognised charge on a separate compact track loader invoice to be checked, which is a standard invoice query.
